arguments.value: This agreement is a 5-year service contract between Rise (Tianjin) Education Information Consulting Co., Ltd. and a service recipient in the children’s English education business. The provider will supply various support services such as academic support, enrollment support, customer service, and possibly human resources, finance, legal, IT, and administrative support. The agreement is non-exclusive, so the provider may serve others too. The recipient must pay quarterly service fees, calculated either by actual cost plus a markup or as a percentage of revenue, and pay to the provider’s designated bank account. All intellectual property created in connection with the services belongs to the provider. Both sides make standard promises that they are properly organized and authorized to sign and perform the contract. The parties must keep information confidential, and breaches can lead to damages; late payment by the recipient triggers 0.5% daily liquidated damages, and if payment is over 15 days late, the provider may terminate the agreement. The agreement can end by expiration, mutual agreement, or the provider’s termination after default. Disputes are to be resolved first by consultation and then by arbitration in Beijing under BAC rules, and the contract renews automatically for another 5 years unless either party gives written notice not to renew.
